title: Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement Terms for Transfers to Another Unit
content:
**Transfer terms.** A tenant may move a Self-Storage Unit Rental Agreement to another unit at the same facility.

(a) A transfer is made only from a rental in active status.
(b) The rental must owe nothing at the time of transfer: its balance due must be zero or below.
(c) The target unit must be shown as available in the facility inventory.
(d) Transfers already made on the agreement — those whose transfer date falls in the rolling 365 calendar days ending on the handling date, inclusive — must number fewer than the class's transfers per rolling 12 months.
(e) The new unit's rent is its posted street rate on the transfer date, with no move-in discount; a military discount already on the agreement carries over.
(f) The transfer fee for the class of the unit being left is posted on the transfer date; the administrative fee is not charged again.
(g) Where the class's transfer terms reset the rate clock, the transfer date becomes the agreement's last rent change date.
(h) Rent already paid for the current billing period stays on the agreement and the difference in rent is first charged from the next due date; the tenant may use the old unit for the class's overlap days after the transfer date to move goods.
(i) A transfer into a unit class whose minimum contents coverage is higher than the tenant's current coverage requires the coverage to be raised first under the coverage rule.

Conditions (a) to (d) are read from the company's records: the agreement's status and balance due, the facility inventory for the target unit, and the agreement's transfer history.

## Checklist with both sides

| Condition | Met | Not met |
|---|---|---|
| status | active | delinquent, moving out or any other status |
| balance due | $0.00 or a credit | any amount owed, however small |
| target unit | available in the inventory | not available |
| transfers in the last 365 days | fewer than the class allowance | equal to the allowance |

## Hypothetical illustration
A tenant with a military discount on a Bluegate Interior Standard agreement, balance $0.00, transfers on 12 May into an available Bluegate Climate Controlled unit posted at $149.00. The new rent is $149.00 with the military discount carried over and no move-in discount; the Interior Standard class's transfer fee is posted on 12 May; the last rent change date becomes 12 May; and the difference in rent is first charged from the next due date.
